Author: Taurenkey (Puni.sh)
Name: Artisan (Zhyra fork)
ChangeLog:
- Internal name changed back to 'Artisan' so other plugins (e.g. GatherBuddy Reborn's 'Import From Artisan') detect it. This fork now replaces the official Artisan rather than installing beside it.
- Sync with upstream: native Craft All button setup moved to the framework thread (stability), simulator now reports insufficient CP instead of erroring, KamiToolKit updated.
- Workshop Presets: save FC Workshop projects (submarines) and spawn or append them to a list without the FC Workshops tab.
